dialogues.speaker: Knyazev
dialogues.text: Haha... If only it were just a scolding. My father even took away the money I was using for business...

dialogues.speaker: Knyazev
dialogues.text: ...Still, he wasn't wrong to do it. I got so dizzy from reading books that I went into business relying on theories from the page, and then I got swindled... Lost everything, down to the last Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Knyazev
dialogues.text: In the end, Father had to step in, clean up my mess, smooth things over with all our partners, and preserve the "last bit of capital" I had left for doing business.

dialogues.speaker: Knyazev
dialogues.text: But Father also told me that if I wanted to enter the business world again and become a merchant, I would have to start from scratch and build up real experience...

dialogues.speaker: Knyazev
dialogues.text: So, following his arrangements, I came here to run this stall... But can this really help me build business experience? Maybe I should go back to studying business theory instead...

dialogues.speaker: Knyazev
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Ah, forget it. Father isn't here anyway...
